in_sanskrit.name: Mahitha
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Greatness, Power
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mahitha एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Mahitha is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'mahith' which means 'great' or 'powerful'. In Hindu mythology, Mahitha is the name of a celestial being or goddess revered for her immense power and wisdom. This name is often given to girls who are believed to possess strong and inspiring qualities.
